name: Commerce Iranian Payment Pack
description: Bundle of seven Iranian bank / PSP off-site redirect payment gateways for Drupal Commerce (Zarinpal, Zibal, Mellat, Melli/Sadad, Saman/SEP, Pasargad, Saderat) that verify each transaction server-side against the bank's API before completing the payment.
library_dependencies: pepco-api/php-rest-sdk (optional; required only for the Pasargad gateway)

suggests.pepco-api/php-rest-sdk: PHP SDK required to use the Pasargad Bank gateway (provides \Pasargad\Pasargad).

project_description:
This module provides some payment gateways for Iranian Banks.
